question: What were our top 5 products by revenue in the last 3 months?
reference_sql: SELECT p.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.sale_price)) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled','Returned') AND oi.created_at >= TIMESTAMP(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1
